'''Toxin mines''' were sabotage devices that released [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gases in order to render crop fields useless. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] used toxin mines against the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]] in an attempt to destroy the settlement's agricultural fields. The natives planted the mines in the soil of the fields, where the gases released by the devices began to destroy the village's crops. The gas was also poisonous to many species, including [[Human/Legends|humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]], and [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]]; one of the village's scouts fell deathly ill when he attempted to investigate the devices. The poisonous effects were not permanently fatal, however, as the villager began to recover after being rescued from the clouds of gas. Three mines were destroyed by the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] in a [[Skirmish in the Kalikori village fields|skirmish]] in the fields when the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] defeated the Flesh Raider saboteurs.<ref name="TOR" />
